intro: Welcome to Omacad. Here are the major features and interface enhancements developed over the last forty-eight hours.
ui: The user interface is completely reimagined. Bulky docked panels and the bottom status bar are gone, replaced by transparent floating overlays and an in-viewport heads-up display.
move: With the new Move Face to Face tool, you can assemble parts by simply clicking two faces, choosing Touch, Flush, or Slide with automatic centering.
section: Section View now features technical diagonal hatching with individual body tints, making complex assemblies effortless to inspect.
thread: Offset Face now natively supports curved surfaces and threads, letting you add precise clearance for friction-free 3D printed threads.
outro: Omacad delivers native speed, clean geometry, and parametric precision for Omarchy Linux. Thank you for watching.
